name: André Franqueira Rodrigues - § 18/1
title: REPORT on the fisheries management approaches for safeguarding sensitive species, tackling invasive species and benefiting local economies
part_text: ‘Urges the Commission to ensure that the EU’s fisheries management approaches are aligned with the CFP, the EU Biodiversity Strategy for 2030 and the EU’s international commitments such as the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework;’
